papers.title: Diagnostic accuracy of computer-aided detection for colorectal polyps of any size, ≤ 5 mm, and 6-9 mm: a meta-analysis
papers.authors: Chen W, Li S, Wu Z, Tan H, Yu F, Wang D
papers.abstract:
BACKGROUND: Although computer-aided detection (CAD) is often used for medical diagnostic purposes, its diagnostic effectiveness in colorectal polyps (CPs) remains uncertain.
OBJECTIVE: To summarize the diagnostic accuracy of CAD in diagnosing CPs, and provide a specific theoretical basis for clinical practice.
METHODS: From database creation to August 1st 2024, we conducted a comprehensive search of PubMed, Embase, Web of Science (WoS), Scopus, Wanfang, Cochrane Library, and the China National Knowledge Infrastructure (CNKI). The pooled sensitivity, specificity, area under the curve (AUC), diagnostic odds ratio (DOR), positive likelihood ratio (PLR), negative likelihood ratio (NLR), and Fagan plot analysis were employed to evaluate the overall performance of CAD tests. Furthermore, we assessed publication bias using Deeks' funnel plot asymmetry test.
RESULTS: The aggregated diagnostic data from 19 studies (any size), 12 studies (≤ 5 mm polyps) and 2 studies (6-9 mm polyps) were as follows: The sensitivity for polyps of any size, ≤ 5 mm, and 6-9 mm was 0.94 (95% CI, 0.92-0.96), 0.93 (95% CI, 0.89-0.95) and 0.95 (95% CI, 0.92-0.97), respectively. The specificity was 0.91 (95% CI, 0.86-0.95), 0.90 (95% CI, 0.87-0.93) and 0.90 (95% CI, 0.88-0.92), respectively. The AUC was 0.97 (95% CI, 0.96-0.99), 0.96 (95% CI, 0.94-0.98), and 0.92 (95% CI, 0.89-0.94), respectively. Deeks' funnel plot showed that publication bias was not statistically significant in the diagnosis of polyps of any size and ≤ 5 mm CPs (P > 0.05).
CONCLUSION: In summary, CAD is accurate for all types of CPs. Specifically, for polyps of any size and those ≤ 5 mm, CAD was more sensitive and specific for CPs of any size.

papers.title_zh: 電腦輔助偵測（CAD）對任意大小、≤5mm及6-9mm大腸直腸息肉之診斷準確度：統合分析
papers.abstract_zh:
背景：雖然電腦輔助偵測（CAD）常用於醫學診斷目的，但其在大腸直腸息肉（CPs）診斷上的效能仍不明確。
目的：總結CAD診斷CPs之診斷準確度，並為臨床實務提供具體理論依據。
方法：從資料庫建立至2024年8月1日，我們全面搜尋PubMed、Embase、Web of Science（WoS）、Scopus、萬方、Cochrane Library及中國知網（CNKI）。採用合併敏感度、特異度、曲線下面積（AUC）、診斷勝算比（DOR）、陽性似然比（PLR）、陰性似然比（NLR）及Fagan圖分析，評估CAD檢測之整體表現。此外，我們使用Deeks漏斗圖不對稱性檢定評估發表偏誤。
結果：來自19篇研究（任意大小）、12篇研究（≤5mm息肉）及2篇研究（6-9mm息肉）之匯總診斷數據如下：任意大小、≤5mm及6-9mm息肉之敏感度分別為0.94（95% CI, 0.92-0.96）、0.93（95% CI, 0.89-0.95）及0.95（95% CI, 0.92-0.97）。特異度分別為0.91（95% CI, 0.86-0.95）、0.90（95% CI, 0.87-0.93）及0.90（95% CI, 0.88-0.92）。AUC分別為0.97（95% CI, 0.96-0.99）、0.96（95% CI, 0.94-0.98）及0.92（95% CI, 0.89-0.94）。Deeks漏斗圖顯示，任意大小及≤5mm CPs之診斷發表偏誤無統計學顯著性（P > 0.05）。
結論：總而言之，CAD對所有類型的CPs均具準確性。特別是對於任意大小及≤5mm的息肉，CAD在CPs之敏感度及特異度上表現更佳。

papers.title: Clinical efficacy of Mepilex Lite dressings combined with indomethacin suppositories in the treatment of acute radiation dermatitis caused by rectal cancer radiotherapy: a study protocol for a randomised controlled trial
papers.authors: Shang H, Yang Y, Cao H, Wu Y, Ji H
papers.abstract:
INTRODUCTION: Acute radiation dermatitis is a common adverse reaction in radiotherapy, especially in patients with rectal cancer undergoing radiotherapy. At present, acute radiation dermatitis of the perianal skin has received widespread attention; however, acute radiation skin injury of the anal canal skin has not received sufficient attention. These patients mainly complain of anal pain, which seriously affects their quality of life. Mepilex Lite dressings have been recommended for the treatment of acute radiation dermatitis and have a definite effect. However, there is limited research on the use of this dressing for the treatment of acute radiation-induced dermatitis of the anal canal skin and its clinical efficacy and safety in this context need further verification.
METHODS AND ANALYSIS: This study is an assessor-blinded randomised controlled trial designed to evaluate the efficacy and safety of Mepilex Lite dressings combined with indomethacin suppositories for the treatment of acute radiation dermatitis of the anal canal skin. A total of 274 eligible patients from the tumour radiotherapy ward of the First Affiliated Hospital of Shandong First Medical University will be randomly assigned to either the experiment or control group (1:1). The control group will be given 30 mg of indomethacin suppositories for rectal administration, and the experiment group will be given Mepilex Lite dressings in addition to the measures taken by the control group. The 5 cm × 5 cm dressing will be inserted into the anal canal for 3 cm through the anus and exposed for 2 cm. The main outcome indicator is the treatment efficiency of the acute radiation dermatitis of the anal canal skin on the 14th day after the intervention. The secondary outcome indicator is the treatment efficiency of the acute radiation dermatitis of the anal canal skin on the seventh and 21st days after the intervention. Concurrently, the Numeric Rating Scale, Hospital Anxiety and Depression Scale, Pittsburgh Sleep Quality Index and Skin Disease Patient Quality of Life Scale-16 will be used to assess patient pain, depression and anxiety, sleep quality and quality of life, respectively. A table questionnaire survey will be conducted at baseline and on 7, 14 and 21 days after intervention.
ETHICS AND DISSEMINATION: The research protocol has obtained ethical approval from the Ethics Committee of the First Affiliated Hospital of Shandong First Medical University (approval number: YXLL-KY-2024 (162)). The results will be published in peer-reviewed journals and abstracts will be submitted to domestic and international conferences to disseminate our research findings.
TRIAL REGISTRATION NUMBER: NCT06837831.

papers.title_zh: Mepilex Lite敷料併用Indomethacin栓劑治療直腸癌放射治療所致急性放射性皮膚炎之臨床療效：一項隨機對照試驗研究方案
papers.abstract_zh:
前言：急性放射性皮膚炎是放射治療常見的不良反應，尤其常見於接受放療的直腸癌患者。目前，肛周皮膚的急性放射性皮膚炎已受到廣泛關注；然而，肛管皮膚的急性放射性皮膚損傷尚未受到足夠重視。這些患者主要抱怨肛門疼痛，嚴重影響其生活品質。Mepilex Lite敷料已被推薦用於治療急性放射性皮膚炎並具有明確效果。然而，關於此敷料用於治療肛管皮膚急性放射性皮膚炎的研究有限，其臨床療效與安全性在此情境下仍需進一步驗證。

方法與分析：本研究為評估人員盲法之隨機對照試驗，旨在評估Mepilex Lite敷料併用indomethacin栓劑治療肛管皮膚急性放射性皮膚炎的療效與安全性。共274名符合條件之患者將自山東第一醫科大學第一附屬醫院腫瘤放療科病房招募，以1:1比例隨機分配至試驗組或對照組。對照組將給予indomethacin栓劑30mg直腸給藥，試驗組則在對照組措施基礎上加用Mepilex Lite敷料。5cm×5cm的敷料將經肛門插入肛管內3cm，露出2cm。主要結果指標為介入後第14天肛管皮膚急性放射性皮膚炎的治療有效率。次要結果指標為介入後第7天及第21天肛管皮膚急性放射性皮膚炎的治療有效率。同時將使用數字評分量表（NRS）、醫院焦慮憂鬱量表（HADS）、匹茲堡睡眠品質指數（PSQI）及皮膚病患者生活品質量表-16（Skindex-16），分別評估患者的疼痛、憂鬱與焦慮、睡眠品質及生活品質。將於基線及介入後第7、14、21天進行問卷調查。

倫理與傳播：本研究方案已獲山東第一醫科大學第一附屬醫院倫理委員會批准（批准號：YXLL-KY-2024 (162)）。研究結果將發表於同儕審查期刊，摘要將提交國內外會議以傳播研究成果。

試驗註冊號：NCT06837831。

papers.title: The Impact of Early Versus Delayed Chemotherapy on Survival in Patients with Colorectal Cancer after Surgery: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis
papers.authors: Wang C, Liu K, Han Y, Xue S
papers.abstract:
OBJECTIVE: This study systematically evaluates the impact of the initiation time of postoperative chemotherapy on overall survival (OS) in patients with colorectal cancer, providing evidence to guide clinical decisions on chemotherapy timing.
METHODS: Following PRISMA and MOOSE guidelines, PubMed, Embase, Web of Science, and the Cochrane Library were systematically searched up to February 2025. Cohort studies comparing early versus delayed postoperative chemotherapy were included. Two researchers independently performed literature screening, data extraction, and quality assessment. Review Manager 5.3 was used, with hazard ratios (HRs) and 95% confidence intervals (CIs) as effect measures. Random- or fixed-effects models were applied based on heterogeneity, and subgroup and sensitivity analyses were conducted.
RESULTS: Eleven studies involving 72,873 patients were included. Pooled results showed that delayed chemotherapy significantly increased the risk of death (HR = 1.32, 95% CI: 1.20-1.45, P < 0.00001). Heterogeneity was high (I² = 88%), and sensitivity analyses confirmed the robustness of the findings. Subgroup analysis, using an 8-week cutoff, revealed that patients who initiated chemotherapy within ≤ 8 weeks had significantly better survival than those who started > 8 weeks (HR = 1.47, 95% CI: 1.14-1.91, P = 0.003).
CONCLUSION: Delayed postoperative chemotherapy markedly increases mortality risk. Initiating adjuvant chemotherapy within 8 weeks after surgery is recommended to achieve optimal survival benefits.

papers.title_zh: 早期與延遲化療對大腸直腸癌術後病人存活的影響：系統性回顧與統合分析
papers.abstract_zh: 目的：本研究系統性評估大腸直腸癌病人術後化療起始時間對整體存活（OS）的影響，為化療時機的臨床決策提供證據。方法：依循PRISMA與MOOSE指引，系統性搜尋PubMed、Embase、Web of Science及Cochrane Library資料庫至2025年2月。納入比較早期與延遲術後化療的世代研究。兩名研究者獨立進行文獻篩選、資料擷取與品質評估。使用Review Manager 5.3，以風險比（HR）與95%信賴區間（CI）作為效應指標，依異質性選擇隨機或固定效應模型，並進行次群組與敏感性分析。結果：共納入11篇研究，涵蓋72,873名病人。合併結果顯示延遲化療顯著增加死亡風險（HR = 1.32，95% CI: 1.20–1.45，P < 0.00001）。異質性極高（I² = 88%），敏感性分析證實結果穩健。以8週為切點的次群組分析顯示，術後≤8週開始化療的病人存活顯著優於>8週者（HR = 1.47，95% CI: 1.14–1.91，P = 0.003）。結論：延遲術後輔助化療會明顯增加死亡風險，建議於術後8週內開始輔助化療以達最佳存活效益。
papers.score_reason: 納入研究皆為觀察性世代研究且異質性極高（I²=88%），存在適應症混淆風險，但樣本量大且結論與現行指引一致，對臨床實務有參考價值。
papers.relevance_why: 術後輔助化療起始時機是大腸直腸外科醫師日常會面臨的臨床決策議題。
papers.one_liner: 在72,873名大腸直腸癌術後病人的11篇世代研究統合分析中，延遲化療較早期化療死亡風險增加（HR 1.32），>8週開始者風險更高（HR 1.47）。

papers.title: Association between inflammatory bowel disease and ankylosing spondylitis: Mendelian randomization of a different database and meta-analysis
papers.authors: Guo J, Qiao Y, Li H
papers.abstract: Inflammatory bowel disease (IBD) and ankylosing spondylitis (AS) are common autoimmune disorders that have a serious impact on the physical and mental health of patients. Some patients with AS also suffer from IBD, and some studies have shown that there is a link between the 2. However, the causal relationship between the 2 is not clear. This study aimed to infer a causal relationship between IBD and AS using Mendelian randomization (MR) analysis. We obtained genome-wide association study data related to IBD and AS from the Integrative Epidemiology Unit database and the Finnish database to infer the causal relationship between IBD and AS. MR analyses were performed using 3 methods, mainly inverse-variance weighting (IVW). The robustness of causal effects was ensured by multiple methods (instrumental variables were assessed using F-values, heterogeneity was detected by Cochran's Q, horizontal pleiotropy was assessed by MR-Egger regression, and outliers were detected by Mendelian Randomization Pleiotropy RESidual Sum and Outlier and leave-one-out methods). Subsequently, we selected genome-wide association studies data from 3 different databases for an independent two-sample MR analysis and a meta-analysis based on 3 independent MR estimates to assess the causal relationship between IBD and AS. There was a positive causal relationship between Crohn disease (CD) and AS with IVW results (odds ratio = 1.19, 95% confidence interval = 1.12-1.27; P <.01). There was a positive causal relationship between ulcerative colitis (UC) and AS with IVW results (odds ratio = 1.60, 95% confidence interval = 1.28-2.00; P <.01). Neither CD nor UC had an inverse causal relationship with AS. In order to verify the accuracy of the results, we performed a meta-analysis of the results obtained from the 3 MR analyses, and the results were consistent with the results we had previously obtained. CD and UC may increase the risk of AS.

papers.abstract_zh: 發炎性腸道疾病（IBD）與僵直性脊椎炎（AS）皆為常見的自體免疫疾病，對患者身心健康造成嚴重影響。部分AS患者同時患有IBD，某些研究顯示兩者存在關聯，但兩者間的因果關係尚不明確。本研究旨在利用孟德爾隨機化（MR）分析推論IBD與AS之間的因果關係。我們從Integrative Epidemiology Unit資料庫及芬蘭資料庫取得IBD與AS相關的全基因組關聯研究（GWAS）數據，以推論兩者的因果關係。MR分析主要採用逆變異數加權法（IVW）等3種方法進行。因果效應的穩健性透過多種方法確保（以F值評估工具變量、以Cochran's Q檢測異質性、以MR-Egger回歸評估水平多效性、以MR-PRESSO及leave-one-out方法檢測異常值）。隨後，我們從3個不同資料庫選取GWAS數據進行獨立的雙樣本MR分析，並基於3個獨立MR估計值進行統合分析，以評估IBD與AS的因果關係。IVW結果顯示克隆氏症（CD）與AS呈正向因果關係（勝算比=1.19，95%信賴區間=1.12-1.27；P<.01）。潰瘍性結腸炎（UC）與AS亦呈正向因果關係（勝算比=1.60，95%信賴區間=1.28-2.00；P<.01）。CD與UC對AS均無反向因果關係。為驗證結果的準確性，我們對3次MR分析所得結果進行統合分析，結果與先前所得結果一致。CD與UC可能增加AS的風險。

papers.title: User perceptions of machine learning models as decision support for colorectal cancer multidisciplinary team conferences (AID-SIM-2): a qualitative simulation study
papers.authors: Bendix Bräuner K, Bruun B, Bertelsen C, Johansen Dagenborg V, Safir-Hansen K, Sanko R
papers.abstract:
BACKGROUND: Multidisciplinary team (MDT) conferences are considered a cornerstone of decision-making in cancer diagnostics and care. However, the current literature has not demonstrated improved patient outcomes based on the decisions of the MDT conferences.
AIM: We aimed to evaluate how four different decision-support modalities impacted the decision-making process and the internal discussions in the MDTs in a multicenter simulation study, with a focus on user perceptions.
METHODS: Four colorectal cancer centers with MDTs participated. We performed four simulations in each center. Each simulation used a different decision-support tool: (1) Current standard, (2) Current standard plus a prediction model, (3) A structured data presentation tool, and (4) A structured data presentation tool plus the prediction model. Clinician- and model-estimated risks were compared, the treatment suggestions from each site were compared, questionnaires about user perceptions were conducted after Simulations 2, 3, and 4 using a Google Form link, and a semi-structured interview was conducted at each site after the last simulation.
RESULTS: Similar distributions of risk groups between clinicians and models were found; however, distinct discrepancies in predictions arose, particularly with higher-risk patients, highlighting the need for standardization for more complex clinical cases. The primary perceived benefit of decision support was increased standardization of care, independent of the individual physicians' personal views. However, participants emphasized the necessity of clinician autonomy to overrule tool suggestions when identifying clinical nuances not captured by the model.
CONCLUSIONS: The colorectal cancer MDTs expressed a positive view regarding the use of prediction models and other forms of decision-support in their workflow. While clinicians and prediction models had similar risk score distributions, they diverged in the assessment of specific individual patients.
papers.title_zh: 使用者對機器學習模型作為大腸直腸癌多學科團隊會議決策支援之觀感（AID-SIM-2）：一項定性模擬研究
papers.abstract_zh: 背景：多學科團隊（MDT）會議被視為癌症診斷與照護決策的基石。然而，目前的文獻尚未證實MDT會議的決策能改善病人預後。目的：我們旨在於一項多中心模擬研究中，評估四種不同的決策支援模式如何影響決策過程及MDT內部討論，重點在於使用者的觀感。方法：四個大腸直腸癌中心的MDT參與本研究，每個中心進行四次模擬，每次模擬使用不同的決策支援工具：(1)目前標準做法、(2)目前標準做法加上預測模型、(3)結構化資料呈現工具、(4)結構化資料呈現工具加上預測模型。研究比較臨床醫師與模型估計的風險，比較各中心的治療建議，在模擬2、3、4之後使用Google表單連結進行使用者觀感問卷調查，並在每個中心最後一次模擬後進行半結構化訪談。結果：臨床醫師與模型之間的風險分組分布相似；然而在預測上出現明顯差異，特別是在高風險病人身上，凸顯出較複雜臨床病例需要標準化的需求。決策支援被認為的主要益處是提升照護標準化，且不受個別醫師個人觀點影響。然而，參與者強調臨床醫師自主性的必要性，以便在辨識出模型未能捕捉到的臨床細微差異時能夠推翻工具建議。結論：大腸直腸癌MDT對於在工作流程中使用預測模型及其他形式的決策支援表達正面看法。雖然臨床醫師與預測模型的風險分數分布相似，但在評估特定個別病人時卻出現分歧。

papers.title: The link between microplastics and colorectal cancer
papers.abstract: Microplastics and nanoplastics (MNPLs) are known to enter the human body and accumulate within different tissues. As MNPLs have been shown to exert toxic effects in vivo, we aimed to evaluate the link between MNPLs and colorectal cancer tumorigenesis. A literature review was conducted, using Ovid MEDLINE and PubMed databases. MeSH terms "colorectal carcinoma" and "microplastic" were the foundations for the search strategy. Forty-one studies were initially identified, of which fourteen were ultimately selected for analysis. MNPLs are found within human colorectal tumors and are present at higher levels in the feces of colorectal cancer patients. The tissue sample studies however are limited by small sample sizes (n = 10 or 25), and are representative of mainly Chinese populations (five of the six human studies conducted in China). The mouse studies observed increased tumor loads and dysbiosis in mice exposed to MNPLs, and the in vitro studies observed increased reactive oxygen species (ROS) when cells were exposed to MNPLs in culture. Although the direct link between MNPLs and de novo development of colorectal cancer remains to be elucidated, these findings suggest that MNPLs can induce the molecular changes involved in tumorigenesis, and tumorigenesis itself when combined with a compromised gastrointestinal barrier. Given that barrier disruption occurs with inflammatory bowel disease, smoking, alcohol, stress, and infections, these populations may be most vulnerable to the effects of MNPLs.
papers.title_zh: 微塑膠與大腸直腸癌之間的關聯
papers.abstract_zh: 微塑膠與奈米塑膠(MNPLs)已知可進入人體並在不同組織中累積。由於MNPLs已被證實在體內具有毒性作用，我們旨在評估MNPLs與大腸直腸癌腫瘤發生之間的關聯。我們使用Ovid MEDLINE與PubMed資料庫進行文獻回顧，以「colorectal carcinoma」與「microplastic」之MeSH詞彙為檢索策略基礎。初步識別出41篇研究，最終選定14篇進行分析。研究發現MNPLs存在於人類大腸直腸腫瘤組織中，且在大腸直腸癌患者糞便中的濃度較高。然而組織樣本研究受限於樣本量極小(n=10或25)，且主要代表中國人群(六篇人體研究中有五篇於中國進行)。小鼠實驗觀察到暴露於MNPLs的小鼠腫瘤負荷增加及腸道菌群失衡；體外實驗則觀察到細胞於培養液中暴露於MNPLs時活性氧(ROS)增加。雖然MNPLs與大腸直腸癌從無到有發生之間的直接因果關係仍待闡明，這些發現提示MNPLs可誘導腫瘤發生相關之分子變化，且在合併腸胃道屏障受損時可誘發腫瘤發生本身。由於發炎性腸道疾病、吸菸、飲酒、壓力及感染皆可導致屏障破壞，這些族群可能最容易受到MNPLs的影響。

papers.title: Beyond Sequence: Posttranslational Remodeling of Antigens in Autoimmunity
papers.authors: Shrestha C, Weisfelder H, Do T
papers.abstract: Autoimmune responses are often attributed to failed tolerance to self-proteins, yet protein expression alone cannot explain why certain antigens dominate disease, why autoreactivity emerges under stress, or why specific HLA alleles shape risk. This review presents a framework in which autoimmunity arises from posttranslational remodeling of antigen identity. Rather than limiting PTMs to side chain chemistry, we consider how covalent modifications, altered processing, aberrant translation, peptide recombination, and supramolecular assembly expand the repertoire of molecular forms available for immune recognition. Classical PTMs such as citrullination, deamidation, oxidation, glycosylation, phosphorylation, sulfation, and ubiquitin-like remnants can modify proteolysis, HLA binding, and antibody recognition. Noncanonical pathways, including signal peptide processing, ERAP-dependent trimming, defective ribosomal products, cryptic ORFs, proteasome-catalyzed splicing, and hybrid insulin peptides, further demonstrate that the presented antigenome extends beyond annotated proteins. We also propose that aggregation functions as a supramolecular antigenic modification by altering uptake, persistence, protease accessibility, and local reaction chemistry. Examples from rheumatoid arthritis, celiac disease, type 1 diabetes, multiple sclerosis, systemic lupus erythematosus, inflammatory bowel disease, and autoimmune thyroid disease illustrate how these mechanisms converge. Finally, we discuss mass spectrometry and immunopeptidomics strategies for identifying, validating, and functionally interpreting remodeled antigens in autoimmune disease.
papers.title_zh: 超越序列：自體免疫疾病中抗原的翻譯後重塑
papers.abstract_zh: 自體免疫反應常被歸因於對自身蛋白質耐受性的失敗，然而單純的蛋白質表現無法解釋為何特定抗原在疾病中占主導地位、為何自體反應性在壓力下出現、或為何特定 HLA 等位基因會影響疾病風險。本綜述提出一個框架，認為自體免疫源於抗原身份的翻譯後重塑。我們不將 PTM（翻譯後修飾）侵限於側鏈化學反應，而是考慮共價修飾、改變的處理過程、異常轉譯、胜肽重組、以及超分子組裝如何擴展可供免疫識別的分子形式庫。經典的 PTM，如瓜氨酸化、去醯胺化、氧化、糖化、磷酸化、硫酸化、以及類泛素殘留物，皆可修飾蛋白酶解、HLA 結合及抗體識別。非經典途徑，包括訊號胜肽處理、ERAP 依賴性修剪、有缺陷的核醣體產物、隱密 ORF、蛋白酶體催化的剪接、以及混合胰島素胜肽，進一步證明呈現的抗原體超越了已註解的蛋白質範圍。我們也提出聚集作用（aggregation）作為一種超分子抗原修飾，透過改變攝取、持續性、蛋白酶可及性及局部反應化學來發揮作用。類風濕性關節炎、乳糜瀉、第一型糖尿病、多發性硬化症、系統性紅斑性狼瘡、發炎性腸道疾病及自體免疫甲狀腺疾病的案例，說明這些機制如何匯聚。最後，我們討論質譜與免疫胜肽組學策略，用於識別、驗證及功能性解讀自體免疫疾病中重塑後的抗原。

papers.title: Region-specific immune regulation determines differential response to JAK1 inhibition in Crohn's disease ex vivo
papers.authors: Grieger K, Dehmel S, Schröder V, Schmidt K, Neufeldt V, Bock L
papers.abstract: Crohn's disease (CD) remains a significant therapeutic challenge, with limited treatment options and heterogeneous clinical responses. The selective JAK1 inhibitor filgotinib has shown great potential in treating ulcerative colitis but failed to demonstrate consistent efficacy in CD, for reasons that remain unclear. Here, we address this gap using an immunocompetent ex vivo model of precision-cut intestinal slices (PCIS) from CD patients, allowing region-specific analysis of ileal and colonic responses. We reveal that colonic PCIS display strong T cell activation and are highly sensitive to filgotinib, with suppression of Th1/Th17 cytokines, oxidative stress, and STAT signaling ex vivo. In contrast, ileal PCIS exhibited predominantly innate and Th17-driven inflammation, and were less sensitive to JAK1 inhibition. These data provide a potential mechanistic explanation for the limited efficacy of filgotinib in CD clinical trials and established PCIS as a human-relevant ex vivo model for region-specific drug responses, underscoring the importance of developing therapies tailored to different segments of the gut in inflammatory bowel disease.

papers.title: Management of Clostridioides difficile Infection in Patients with Inflammatory Bowel Disease
papers.abstract: Clostridioides difficile is a gram-positive, anaerobic bacteria that is ubiquitous. Oral-fecal transmission of the organism and its spores leads to C difficile colonization and infection (CDI) within the human gastrointestinal tract. Patients with inflammatory bowel disease (IBD) are more likely to be colonized with C difficile, develop CDI, and experience recurrence when compared to the general population. The biggest challenge of managing CDI in IBD remains diagnostic uncertainty and relies on clinicians' judgment.

papers.authors: Weyant R, Gîlcă-Blanariu G, Fischer M, Kao D
papers.abstract: Severe and fulminant Clostridioides difficile infection (CDI) represent distinct clinical entities that portend poor outcomes and require close monitoring and multidisciplinary management. Early recognition is key, and CDI-directed antimicrobials are the mainstay of therapy. If patients fail to improve despite maximal medical therapy, fecal microbiota transplantation (FMT) or surgical intervention should be considered. If FMT is performed, repeated dosing is often required. Surgical interventions such as colectomy or loop ileostomy are necessary in FMT nonresponders or those who have developed a complication such as perforation.

papers.title: Pharmacological modulation of the PD-1/PD-L1 axis: from immune tolerance in colitis to immune escape in colorectal cancer
papers.journal_full: European review for medical and pharmacological sciences
papers.authors: Grimaldi R, Balestrero F, Meggiolan A, Serra M, Ferramosca A, Travelli C
papers.abstract: In recent years, immune-based therapies, particularly checkpoint inhibitors, have been developed to interfere with tumor immune escape. Among various molecular targets, the PD-1/PD-L1 axis represents a central mechanism of tumor-driven immune evasion and a major target for restoring T-cell-mediated anti-tumor activity. Several blocking monoclonal antibodies have been developed to restore antitumor immunity, and anti-PD-1/PD-L1 antibodies have transformed the treatment of solid tumors, including colorectal cancer (CRC). In the colon, the PD-1/PD-L1 axis plays a dual and context-dependent role. During the early stages of intestinal inflammation, such as in inflammatory bowel disease (IBD), PD-1/PD-L1 signaling contributes to immune tolerance and mucosal protection. However, persistent activation of this pathway may become detrimental during the colitis-to-cancer transition, promoting immune evasion and tumor progression. Immune checkpoint inhibitors, such as nivolumab and pembrolizumab, currently approved for specific subsets of CRC, exert their effects by blocking the interaction between PD-1 and PD-L1, thereby restoring antitumor immune responses. Their use, either as monotherapy or in combination regimens, has demonstrated promising efficacy in advanced and mismatch repair-deficient CRC. This review summarizes the biphasic role of PD-1/PD-L1 in IBD and CRC, with particular emphasis on the therapeutic application of PD-1/PD-L1 blockade in CRC. It highlights monoclonal antibody-based approaches and emerging combination strategies, and finally examines current clinical trial evidence, highlighting ongoing challenges, including primary and acquired resistance to anti-PD-1/PD-L1 therapies.

papers.abstract_zh: 近年來，以免疫為基礎的療法，特別是免疫檢查點抑制劑，已被開發用於干擾腫瘤的免疫逃逸。在各種分子靶點中，PD-1/PD-L1軸代表腫瘤驅動免疫逃逸的核心機制，也是恢復T細胞介導抗腫瘤活性的主要靶點。已開發出多種阻斷性單株抗體以恢復抗腫瘤免疫，抗PD-1/PD-L1抗體已改變包括大腸直腸癌（CRC）在內的實體腫瘤治療方式。在大腸中，PD-1/PD-L1軸扮演雙重且依情境而異的角色。在腸道發炎早期階段，例如發炎性腸道疾病（IBD），PD-1/PD-L1訊號傳導有助於免疫耐受性與黏膜保護。然而，此路徑的持續活化在大腸炎轉變為癌症的過程中可能變得有害，促進免疫逃逸與腫瘤進展。免疫檢查點抑制劑如nivolumab與pembrolizumab目前已核准用於特定CRC亞群，其作用機轉為阻斷PD-1與PD-L1之間的交互作用，藉此恢復抗腫瘤免疫反應。無論作為單一療法或併用療法，其使用已在晚期及錯配修復缺陷（mismatch repair-deficient）CRC中展現出令人期待的療效。本篇綜述總結了PD-1/PD-L1在IBD與CRC中的雙相角色，並特別強調PD-1/PD-L1阻斷在CRC中的治療應用。文中重點介紹以單株抗體為基礎的方法與新興的併用策略，最後檢視目前的臨床試驗證據，並強調現存挑戰，包括對抗PD-1/PD-L1療法的原發性與後天性抗藥性。
